reviews.title: An Awful Company Who’s Staff Are Ashamed To Work For
reviews.text: We were due to fly for the Canada for the premier of our feature film. The airline refused to allow my wife on the flight as their system had not been updated to show that UAE Nationals could fly to Canada with a ETA not a full visa. This change occurred in 2018!!! Their system had not been updated for 4 years!!! The check in staff agreed that we should be able to fly but they could not override the system to generate a boarding pass!!!! In the company’s system’s eyes we did not have the documents to travel, although we did, so check-in staff were not sure if we will even get our money back!!!! They also said not to use their wifi or the mobile app for refunds as their IT systems were not good. No Sh!t!!!! This has cost us thousands of dollars and meant that we missed a once in a lifetime experience. It also means that our audience in Montréal miss out on what they paid for, a conversation with the directors of a film that they are going to be one of the first to watch in the world. The check-in staff were lovely, but frustrated and shamed by the company they were working for. The desk manager said she was looking for another job. I wish her all the best!

reviews.title: 2 Passengers have to pay extra to sit together
reviews.text: Horrible service, I have never in my entire life experienced any airliner who refuses to seat 2 passengers together... until flying with Corsair. I was given seat 46D while my girlfriend was given seat 14K... When trying to change seat upon check-in it showed literally EVERY OTHER SEAT as PREMIUM and had to pay between 15-40 EUR extra in order to change seat. There was nothing premium about these seats as our seats 46D and 14K both showed up as 'PREMIUM' seats as well as soon as we changed to other seats. Horrible practise to force people extra money out of their pockets just to be able to sit together on a 9 hour flight. Even one star is too much in my opinion.
reviews.author: Melv1337

reviews.title: Staff misread Covid rules, lacked geographical knowledge and we nearly missed our flight
reviews.text: We were checking in at Marseille, France to fly to Reunion Island (also French territory). My partner is French and I hold a UK passport. Because French Overseas Territories all have different rules about entering during Covid, we triple-checked the requirements beforehand: all we needed was proof that we had been vaccinated. What could possibly go wrong? We got there 3 hours before boarding time just to be safe. At the check-in counter, my partner checks in without a hitch. When the airline staff saw my passport, she did a double take, as if it had never occurred to her that anyone non-French would travel to Reunion Island. She asked, 'Are you sure that you don't require a visa to travel to Reunion Island, with your British passport?' I also do a double-take. We were *already in France*. Why would I need a visa to travel to another French territory? Sure, there was Brexit, but we were definitely not at the point of requesting visas from British people to travel in the EU! So I said no, I'm quite sure I don't need a visa to travel to...France...since I'm...already in France...and I got here without a visa just several days ago. She then double checks and says, okay yes, you're right, BUT it says here on this official airline database that British people require 1) a vaccination certificate AND 2) a negative test result in order to fly to France. And I'm like...no. According to the official UK gov site and Reunion site, I don't need both, just either. I also was able to fly to France from Hong Kong with only my vaccination certificate. She then asks a colleague, who says that 'rules change all the time and we reject people from boarding all the time too. There is nothing we could do.' Then she asks my partner (we had been holding up the line for 45 minutes now) to look at the official database with her to make sure he understands what she's trying to say. That was nice of her - normally they just insist they're right. But she admitted it was her first day on the job and she wanted to make double sure. So my partner takes a close look at said database and reads (originally in French): "British travellers to this destination are required to produce: i) a valid vaccination certificate by x, y z companies; or ii) a negative Covid test result within 72 hours of departure time" So he said to the staff, 'It says "or" over here. She's vaccinated. So she doesn't need the Covid test." And would you believe it...the airline staff began to insist that "or" actually meant..."and". *Keep in mind that she was French, and the document was in French, too.* As the current state of humanity began to sink in for me, I saw that the queue had gone and we were the last at the check-in counters. Airline staff were being asked to close off baggage check-in. We were going to miss our flight because of a supposed debate over the meaning of the word 'or'. Finally, after much begging on our part, she gets her manager to check the situation, to which the manager goes, 'What on earth are you going on about? Just let them check in already!' And that was that. Still no apology but I bet the staff member was super embarrassed already at her mistake. I'm willing to believe she had a case of bad nerves that day, but there really should be safeguards in place to prevent this kind of error.

reviews.title: Corsair and trip.com continue to cheat
reviews.text: Booked flight with Corsair Airlines on January 20, 2020. Never received a confirmation or a ticked issued from airlines, but only from trip.com. After Coronavirus outbreak I enquired several times to both Corsair (via phone and email) and trip.com on the status of my flight. On March 23 I have found an update regarding my flight on Corsair's official website stating that it had been canceled. Contacted again both corsair and trip.com providing them with the evidence found. Only trip.com replied and denied having updates on my flight refusing to answer for the details of my refund and redirecting me to contact again Corsair asking them for a 'written statement'(whaaat??). Corsair still fails to answer. To this day I am still denied the refund for the flight booked and the service the carrier canceled. P.S. Easyjet has promptly refunded my connecting flight two weeks ago.

The first time I thought that the agent was in bad mood ( not enough sleep, not feeling well....) but the second time around I begin to believe it is the company ‘s policy ( the flight was from Montreal to Paris at 19:45 on March 12, 2020 ) I am 68 year's old and 1m55. reviews.title: Horrible Experience with Corsair.
reviews.text: I travel with my wife and my youngest son from Miami to Paris with corsair. I booked my tickets through orbitz. When I booked, I saved my booking confirmation screenshot which is the only proof that save my money from rip off. When I booked, it's clearly stated one bag check in is free up to 23 kg. So we are all took one piece of luggage to check in as 23 kg. When we check in at Miami airport Corsair counter, They said I have to pay $115.00 each for our one piece check in luggage, I show them my screenshot of my booking. Then they said that we don't know because you book through third party travel agent. I said I always book through orbitz and never had any issues with them. I also booked another flight from Paris to Bangalore, India through orbitz which was Etihad airways which I never had any problems to check in my bag as orbitz stated on my booking. When I came back form France to Miami, Corsair charge me another 100 euro each for our one pices. For this trip my budget was $1500 for paris trip and I took cash with me. But, traveling with cors air it's hurt me big time because they took my $645.00 for the luggage and we end up with $865.00 budget. So, We couldn't do much for the little budget and corsair ruin our 25th year wedding anniversary trip. We were so disappointed. I thank Etihad air ways to provide a fat better service with their A380 flight from Paris to Bangalore. They didn't fake us and charge extra money for our luggage. Etihad air kept their promise and gave us excellent service to us. They even offer us a upgrade business class for only $250.00 which I couldn't afford because of Corsair took our $645.00 unexpectedly. Thank God for saving my booking confirmation screenshot. When I called orbitz and complained about this, They ask me to send the screenshot for the proof in order to get my refund. I send it to orbitz and they refund my money. Corsair is fake and their flight seat were so small for nine hours of long flight. Alos when we come to the airport they charge $115.00 for each check in pieces which is rip off. If they would say that they are charging us for luggage, Then i understand their business. But unfortunate and we don't know their gimmick and we get neil down at the airport, We will be very upset and very disappointment though. I never book with corsair again. I suggest all travelers Please avoid fling with Corsair.
reviews.author: Tomson Chacko

reviews.title: Below zero customer service follow up on several issues
reviews.text: Experience to share to all people who plan to travel with Corsair International from / to Montréal.... or anywhere else we book our flights to go back in france to see our families for Christmas holidays. We have experienced the below zero customer service follow up. On the way to Paris, one of our 2 seats was broken. This had not just happened no no the hostess told us « ah yes this seat is a bit temperamental... let me ask my colleague to try to fix it »... so for 15 minutes a crew member tried to have the seat moving and well he did not... A little shame when you on purpose of getting some rest specifically réserve business class.... We fill a complaint online .... and receive a sorry email stating ... well sorry here is a 70€ discount for your next trip with us.... Not even the half of the difference between economic seat and business... we argue this discount as we don’t feel it is compensating... no answer to our email. I call the customer service. First call the agent listen to the purpose of my call and put me on hold.... for 15 minutes ... simply waiting that I put down the phone.... I call back, the person starts to investigate the case and after 19 minutes oh well the line cuts.... am i not unlucky??!! So 3rd call and there I have the agent telling me sorry I can’t anything. For any possible upgrade you have to check directly at the airport when you go back to Montreal... So we did And there first agent send us to a supervisor... can not do anything for us as any request should be sent by email to the sales department... We ask to see the manager, no problem we just have to wait that he finishes to dean with the overbooking of the flight to Fort de France... So we do... 40minutes There the person tells us sorry he can not do anything else than give is exit seats with more room for the legs... that’s the best you can do so ok we take them... In the plane the crew has been communicated we had issues on the first way but nobody came around to check if we were ok or else... Until the meal is served and I grab the tablet to put the ray on it... As unlucky as I can be... it is unscrewed and my tray slide and almost fell .... I had to have it sitting on te top of my book on the top of my knee......... so comfy!!!!!! Ok so arrived in Montréal, flight is over and we go to grab our lugage... On of our suitcase has been so badly treated that there are now 2 holes in the back, the telescopic handle can no longer be used as the bars are so badly damaged that it is stuck in.... The top handle is also damaged... So here we are..... we go to report it at the airport, the agent notify this and provide me the file papers instructing me to file a complaint with Corsair international So I do... the next day I receive an email saying that they require a professional to inspect the lugage and certify if it can or not be repaired, the cost of repair or the cost of replacement So I do I go to Laval to have this checked and the lady I see there tells me it is so bad it can not be repaired. So I get the certificate and send it as a response se to the email received. I wait 5-7 business days... no answer I send another email.... no answer Last night I sent a third email asking to have some updates / news or any sort of feedback Nothing ... Seriously Corsair what’s wrong with you?? Customer service is really lacking of care ... no follow up.... to all my friends and all of the people thinking that saving a few dollars to fly with them is worth it... think of it twice We have to buy a new suitcase (around 200$) as the damaged one is only good for the bin I will seriously think of any other airlines before booking with @corsair international again ...

reviews.title: Terrible service, uncomfortable flight
reviews.text: First off, the only positive aspect: the flight arrived on time.. That's why it gets the second star from me. Everything else was a disaster... The staff was rude, unfriendly and couldn't care less about the passengers. We wanted to switch seats to a free area after completing the boarding and were refused. Other people occupied these seats, just because they switched in secret. Almost no drinks were served in flight, people were referred to the area in the front. Though, 70% of the time the seat belt sign was on although there were almost no turbulences. The food was atrocious.. The seats were old and hardened, the entertainment programme was a joke. I'll avoid that airline in the future and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone else...

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE EVER!
reviews.text: THIS IS THE WORST AIRLINE EVER! I was supposed to fly with them on 9/16 from Paris to Miami. On 9/15 at 6:00pm,I got an email saying that the flight was cancelled. I tried calling customer service but they were closed (not open on weekends). I woke up on 9/16 and took a cab to the airport to talk to someone. The Corsair agent told me she couldn't help me but I can come back in 3 days to see If they are flying. I asked if they would pay for my hotels and expenses,she said "I don't know ma'am. You have to call customer service. All we can do is give you a refund. Take it or wait for 3 days." I was SHOCKED! I had a baby and a sick mother trying to get back to the US and Corsair did not make it easy. I ended up spending $1k in hotels because it was last minute and most places were booked. I filed a claim with them and never heard back. Customer service keeps telling me to send an email to some department. I really hope they give me a refund for the hotel since they cancelled last minute.I didn't get home until 9.20.
reviews.author: Dream639933

reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK CORSAIR AIRLINE EVER!
reviews.text: After my recent experience September 18th 2019 with Corsair I felt obligated to take the time to inform all possible future passengers that I would recommend you to do WHATEVER it takes NOT to book this airline! In brief this was my experience: 1) Delayed departure time by 1 hour 2) Canceled flight after waiting on the plane for 4 hours 3) Falsely promised that we will be contacted the following day with rebooking options 4) Falsely offered alternative re-routing options 5) Rerouted option downgraded level of service from previous booked flight 6) Confirmed on rebooked flight a day later only to find out upon arrival at Miami airport that we were actually on STANDBY! 7) No offer to assist with rebooking of connecting flight that we would be subsequently missing due to their cancelation. 8) No immediate compensation of payment for upgrade, offer of meal vouchers, drink vouchers, or transportation fees - all of this had to be entered at their website which we received notification that we would be contacted after 48 hours - we are now 5 days later. 9) Oh and you'll love this one - for the inflight entertainment you had to use your fingernail to press the buttons - it was that crap for a transatlantic flight! 10) The two agents that I spoke to on the phone were down right rude - with one of them disconnecting me 3 times and then when they did "confirm" my flight they just hung up - I had to call back each time to get more information - it was a JOKE! Now the return flight - yup guess what that was CANCELED TOO! Here's the email received the night before our flight: "Dear Customer, Following the unavailability of one of our aircraft, your flight SS918 of September 23, 2019 is modified as follows: Départure from Paris on septembre 25th at 11.40 AM Arrival at Miami at 03.50 PM the same day Check-in at terminal Orly 4 , from 7.40 AM, flight n° SS918 Corsair regrets these time changes and apologizes to its customers and our sales team will contact you to find an alternative solution. Thank you for your understanding. Customer service" We were supposed to leave on September 23!!! And now they have us booked for the 25th! Trust me no customer service rep contacted us EVER! We only found out about this change when we arrived at the airport as we were traveling with no internet connection. So how the return flight went: 1) Arrival at Orly airport to find out flight had been canceled. 2) Called airline while waiting in service line to get flight rebooked and best they could do was a later flight that day from CDG with Air France 3) No offer of a bus transfer between the airports - again this had to be filed online for compensation. 4) Confirmation on the phone that we were definitely on the flight and that we were NOT ON STANDBY. 5) Arrival at CDG, checkin with Air France to find out we were on STANDBY - LIED TO AGAIN! 6) Missed subsequent connecting flight due to cancelation and another night spent in Miami. Considering the extreme level of stress, financial payments that had to be made, and loss of valuable vacation time, (it was the 20th reunion with two close friends that I only see 3 days a year) I CAN NOT STRESS ENOUGH THAT NO MATTER THE ADDITIONAL COST ANOTHER AIRLINE MAY BE - CHOOSE THEM NOT CORSAIR! Do yourself a favour don't book Corsair.

reviews.text: Run away people, this is a bad bad company They lost my bag.. this is the third day ive been trying to reach them, in vain, imagine this company doesnt have any phone number nor email adress, i just cant connect to them.. i live in Montreal Canada They're cheap cheap to the point that the hostess wouldnt give me an extra piece of bread.. thank god i had my pringles.. reviews.author: Elie H

reviews.title: Horrible airline!
reviews.text: Do not fly Corsair!!! It is a horrible airline. I was not aware that one of my tickets did not include baggage. But the other 4 did. They made me pay 285 euros for my bag. I asked how I could fix that issue and the answer was, NO!. The people the work at Corsair are passive aggressive. Perhaps they are not happy with their jobs, so they will not help or assist you making things better. The food on the plain was also horrible. We were stop at at least 4 check points in the airport by Corsair and we were asked the same dumb questions, why were we visiting Paris. Like really?! Shouldn't that have been asked coming in? The whole experience left a very bitter taste in my mouth.
reviews.author: Isabel

reviews.title: Worst Airline I Have Ever Flown With
reviews.text: If you chose to fly with Corsair, or any of its representatives that sell their flights online, be aware of the fact that they do not take responsibility for any misrepresentation by their employees or the agencies that they use to sell their tickets. The agency that we booked through did not inform us that the economy flight we purchased did not include baggage. It did refer us to the website, which indicates that economy flights include one bag. When I went to check us in however, there was zero baggage allowance. Apparently the agency booked us with "basic" economy, but neglected to inform us of that anywhere on their website or in our intinery. As a result, we had to pay an extra $260 to change our flight. The Corsair agent informed us that this would cover our bags for our trip. It did not. When leaving France, we were forced to pay another 200€ to bring out bags back home. So we paid an extra $580 CAD, to fly with Corsair. I will never fly with them again. Employees are not empowered to assist you more than to give you a customer service number. This number doesn't work during business hours. If you do get customer service on the phon, they won't help you either. Book Air Canada or Air France if you don't want any surprises.
reviews.author: Bee

reviews.title: What you pay is what you get
reviews.text: Bought a bargain ticket from Paris to Montreal and as soon as I boarded the old plane, I quickly understood why was it so cheap. Everything is outdated, entertainment systems were not working, food was very bad and of course it wasn't on time at all. Further, they charged me 30€ for my vegetarian meal, but the rest of the people got it for free. Corsair, are you out of your freaking mind?

reviews.title: Cattle Transport
reviews.text: A rather new _437 Boing plane and a 6 pm departure made the trip acceptable. 535 co-passengers gave us a strong feeling of taking part in a cattle transport.
reviews.author: CMSilfverberg

reviews.title: Way better than you would expect
reviews.text: I've spent a few hours digging into Corsair Airlines' review after booked a ticket to FDF. I must say the reviews are really slid into a bad direction. There was no delay, no lost luggage or really any significant problem on these flights. Only negative thing I can add is that the cabin crew is not really nice or at least those who were serving us. I know it is really tiring to work on an 8 and a half hours flight, but some improvement would be more than welcomed. Besides this small issue, I am more than happy to fly with Corsair in the future as well.
reviews.author: Istvansajti

reviews.title: NEVER buy Corsair flights!!!
reviews.text: My flights to Reunion in December 2018 were changed due to radicalized Yellow Vests social movements. No traffic, fuel, food in the island. They refused to refund the flight until last moment and when they did, they issued coupon instead of cash (rival Air Austral had full cash refund). Problem is, Corsair destinations are crap (Africa, French territories...) so it's impossible to use this coupon to go somewhere you really want. When you finally decide to buy tickets using the coupon, the website refuses to initialize the password needed to log in to my account. Impossible to buy tickets. Even before I fly Corsair, I know that I will NEVER EVER buy Corsair again!!!!!
reviews.author: SOS

reviews.title: Delays, lost baggage, poor service
reviews.text: Wouldn’t recommend flying with Corsair long haul. 1) 3 hour delay in orly airport meant we missed our connection flying out. 2) on the return they lost 2/3 bags - without apology. 3) no vegetarian food ok flight - this has to be ordered - we were not aware. On the way back I had no food. 4) only one meal offered on an 8 hour flight - with a 3 hour delay this wasn’t enough. On return we were offered a “gouté” pack - more substantial on the flight without delay. 5) on return one staff member was very moody for no reason. First time about heating baby food, second time about us not being served coffee (although everyone else was!) All other staff were pleasant but we barely saw them. 6) the plane felt quite old and had had its day. Some of our screens didn’t work. 7) couldn’t do online check in 8) price only a few hundred different in total to fly with airfrance and hugely regret that decision! Especially as we have no news on our bags. Plus points - Our daughter (18 months) was given a baby bed which meant she was very comfortable on the flight. We had lots of leg room as were placed in really good seats. Looking at other people, for a long haul flight they had barely any leg room.
